text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I are on our way
back from a
day out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe the day is over
already. Time
truly does fly when you're
having fun...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful time, but that has
been enough
enjoyment for one day. I
ought to get ready to
for tomorrow's
cla—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, something in the
supermarket
window catches Symboli
Rudolf's attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Stuffed peppers do sound awfully
good...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind waiting here a moment?
I'm just
going to buy ingredients for
tomorrow's lunch.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, if you're certain, I could
hardly refuse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the help. I can turn these
into quite
the nutritious lunch tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Usually, yes. As a Tracen Academy
student, it's
my duty to monitor the food
I consume.
choice_data_list: お弁当、毎日作ってるのか？
お弁当、毎日作ってるの？
choice_data_list_en: Do you make your lunch every day?
Do you make your lunch every day?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The food served in the cafeteria is
designed to
meet our nutritional needs,
of course...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But seeing as the student council office
doubles
as a place to seek advice, I
would prefer not to
vacate it during the
lunch period.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I try to bring a packed
lunch to eat
there whenever I can.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah! What an odd thing to fixate on. I
cannot
imagine it would be especially
interesting to look
at...
choice_data_list: 毎日作るのは大変そう
choice_data_list_en: I'd love to see your lunch!
Making it every day sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would also be a little embarrassed to
simply waft
my lunch under your nose.
What do you say I
make you one too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You help me every day. I would only be
returning
the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, cooking for one makes it
remarkably
difficult to avoid wasting
food.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I often find myself obliged to donate
excess
portions to Brian and Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, they've told me this
directly,
so I'll warn you in advance...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My lunches are known for looking quite
plain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, I get the chance to
try Symboli
Rudolf's cooking for myself.
It won't win any
awards for presentation,
but it tastes extremely
nutritious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It can be onerous at times, but the
benefits are
worth the effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For one thing, having a task before me
first thing
in the morning helps me to
wake up full of
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Against the temptations of slumber, I
levy the
shield of diligence and the
sword of appetite.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Oops.
choice_data_list: 寝起き、あまりよくないのか？
寝起き、あまりよくないの？
choice_data_list_en: Not much of a morning person, are you?
Not much of a morning person?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You're as perceptive as ever, I
see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you correctly deduced, I'm not a
naturally
early riser.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I take measures to ensure that it doesn't
affect my
responsibilities, but there's no
changing my
constitution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, this is strictly confidential
information.
Nobody below
vice-presidential level must know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's smile turns just a little

mischievous.
